info.title: AI Gateway API
info.description: A unified API gateway for multiple AI providers. OpenAI-compatible ops are served under /{app_id}/v1/*; other paths under /{app_id} are rejected.

get.summary: OIDC discovery document for the demo JWT auth issuer
get.description: Minimal OpenID discovery document so OpenIdJwtInboundPolicy can resolve this gateway as a stand-in issuer for local testing of generic-jwt-auth-inbound, matching how a real IDP (Okta, Auth0, etc.) exposes discovery metadata. Point JWT_ISSUER/JWT_JWKS_URL at your real IDP instead for production.

get.summary: JWKS for the demo JWT auth issuer
get.description: Publishes the public key used to verify JWTs minted by scripts/mint-demo-jwt.mjs, for local testing of generic-jwt-auth-inbound without a real IDP.

get.summary: Look up this hour's $ spend quota usage for the caller
get.description: Verifies the caller's JWT with generic-jwt-auth-inbound, then reports their spend against generic-cost-quota-inbound's hourly $ limit, for visualizing usage in a client UI.

200.description: Current $ spend and limit for this caller

get.summary: Mock completion for exercising the cost quota without a real model
get.description: Requires generic-jwt-auth-inbound, then runs generic-cost-quota-inbound before returning a synthetic OpenAI-shaped completion whose token usage is set via ?model=, ?promptTokens=, ?completionTokens= query params. Lets you drive a caller's simulated spend up to (and past) the $2/hour limit without calling or paying for a real AI provider.

200.description: Synthetic completion response with usage/model fields

429.description: Hourly $ quota exceeded for this caller

get,post,put,patch,delete,head.description: Routes AI requests under /{app_id}/* to the AI Gateway handler. The configuration loader loads the application configuration from the app_id path segment; the configuration executor then runs the application's inboundPolicyChain. Only paths whose suffix is a supported /v1/... operation succeed; see resolveBasePath in packages/runtime/src/llm-translation/index.ts for the current set. Anything else under /{app_id} returns 404.

401.description: Unauthorized — returned only when the application's inboundPolicyChain includes ai-gateway-auth-v2-inbound, or authentication runs before the configuration loader

403.description: Forbidden — returned by per-app policies, such as an API key issued for a different app_id or a model the app does not allow
